failures.assertion: Defines Button props with their defaults (intent, size and type, with type defaulting to button) and maps its hover, focus-visible, disabled and loading states to semantic token roles
failures.evidence: The props and defaults are present (`type?: "button" | "submit" | "reset"; // default "button"`), but the state mapping "(`bg`, `bgHover`, `bgActive`, `focus.ring`, `disabled.*`)" gives the loading state no token role; loading is only described as "aria-busy, label kept, clicks ignored".

failures.assertion: Defines FormField props with a required control id tied to the label, a hint, and an error that sets aria-invalid and points aria-describedby at the displayed message
failures.evidence: The control id is optional rather than required (`id?: string; // default useId()`), even though hint and error are wired via "`aria-describedby` lists the hint and error ids" and the error sets aria-invalid.

failures.assertion: Writes typography sizes, weights, line heights and letter spacing, with em-based tracking converted because DTCG dimensions allow only px and rem, or says why
failures.evidence: Sizes, weights, line heights and tracking are written, but tracking such as "tight": { "value": -0.01, "unit": "rem" } just swaps em for rem without converting the value per font size, and the output never says why.

failures.assertion: Recommends recording which level the system targets
failures.evidence: The output only says to "document both numbers as tokens", labelling 24px the "(AA) floor" and 44px the default, and never recommends recording which conformance level the system targets.
